Each ambition's goal is shown plainly with its progress; its legacy shows only its name until earned. requires: what must hold before the ambition can be drawn (a chain on an earlier ambition done, a campaign event, or fitness). Conditions name other realms by catalogue id. Wired into the engine elsewhere.
